mapper.select: SELECT l.ad_lease_id, l.contract_code, l.ad_position_code, l.ad_location, l.single_side_area, l.total_ad_area, l.ad_specification, l.lessee_code, l.lessee_company, l.lease_rent, l.lease_term, l.lease_start_date, l.lease_end_date, l.contract_sign_date, l.version, l.approval_status, l.submitted_by_username, l.submitted_at, l.approver_username, l.approved_at, l.approval_comment, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ad_lease_attachment a WHERE a.ad_lease_id=l.ad_lease_id) AS attachment_count FROM t_ad_lease_detail l ORDER BY l.lease_start_date DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT ad_lease_id, contract_code, ad_position_code, ad_location, single_side_area, total_ad_area, ad_specification, lessee_code, lessee_company, lease_rent, lease_term, lease_start_date, lease_end_date, contract_sign_date, version, approval_status, submitted_by_username, submitted_at, approver_username, approved_at, approval_comment, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ad_lease_attachment a WHERE a.ad_lease_id=l.ad_lease_id) AS attachment_count FROM t_ad_lease_detail l WHERE ad_lease_id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ad_lease_detail (contract_code, ad_position_code, ad_location, single_side_area, total_ad_area, ad_specification, lessee_code, lessee_company, lease_rent, lease_term, lease_start_date, lease_end_date, contract_sign_date, approval_status) VALUES (#{contractCode}, #{adPositionCode}, #{adLocation}, #{singleSideArea}, #{totalAdArea}, #{adSpecification}, #{lesseeCode}, #{lesseeCompany}, #{leaseRent}, #{leaseTerm}, #{leaseStartDate}, #{leaseEndDate}, #{contractSignDate}, #{approvalStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ad_lease_detail SET contract_code=#{lease.contractCode}, ad_position_code=#{lease.adPositionCode}, ad_location=#{lease.adLocation}, single_side_area=#{lease.singleSideArea}, total_ad_area=#{lease.totalAdArea}, ad_specification=#{lease.adSpecification}, lessee_code=#{lease.lesseeCode}, lessee_company=#{lease.lesseeCompany}, lease_rent=#{lease.leaseRent}, lease_term=#{lease.leaseTerm}, lease_start_date=#{lease.leaseStartDate}, lease_end_date=#{lease.leaseEndDate}, contract_sign_date=#{lease.contractSignDate}, version=version+1 WHERE ad_lease_id=#{lease.adLeaseId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted=0

UPDATE t_ad_lease_detail SET approval_status='PENDING', submitted_by_username=#{username}, submitted_at=NOW(), approver_username=NULL, approved_at=NULL, approval_comment=NULL, version=version+1 WHERE ad_lease_id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND approval_status IN ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED') AND deleted=0

UPDATE t_ad_lease_detail SET approval_status=#{approvalStatus}, approver_username=#{username}, approved_at=NOW(), approval_comment=#{comment}, version=version+1 WHERE ad_lease_id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND approval_status='PENDING' AND deleted=0
UPDATE t_ad_lease_detail SET deleted=1, version=version+1 WHERE ad_lease_id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted=0 AND approval_status IN ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED')
